title: Add VehicleWing3D node for wing physics simulation
body:
VehicleWing3D used as a child of a VehicleBody3D parent to simulate the behavior of one of its wings. There are settings for flexible adjustment of the wing shape, control surfaces and aerodynamics. The aerodynamic formulas used here are from the paper "Real-time modeling of agile fixed-wing UAV aerodynamics" by Khan and Nahon 2015 https://www.researchgate.net/publication/264773227_Dynamics_Modeling_of_a_Highly-Maneuverable_Fixed-Wing_UAV.
